messages:
Reject sparse patches and sparse or cyclic values in applyPatch

A hole in a sparse patch array was skipped instead of being reported as
an operation that is not an object, a sparse array in a value was
accepted and copied with its holes, and a cyclic value overflowed the
stack with a RangeError instead of raising an InvalidPatchError. The
value member is now also read once. ADR 0002 (version 2) and the README
record the rule.
